Lester 是你的 AI 工作区。描述目标、提供材料，让 Agent 帮你整理: Lester is your AI workspace. Describe a goal and provide materials for an agent to organize documents, analyze data or build a website. Then review and refine the results.
大约 1 分钟 · 可以随时退出，稍后继续: About 1 minute · Leave anytime and resume later
模型负责理解任务与生成内容。可以使用管理员提供的共享模型，也可以在「模型」设置中: Models understand tasks and generate content. Use an administrator's shared model or connect your service in Models. If none is available, save a draft before setup.
配置已保存 ≠ 模型已验证。首次实际运行才会确认服务是否可调用。: Configuration saved ≠ model verified. The first real run checks provider access.
告诉它：你想得到什么: Tell it what you want to get
在输入框写下目标、受众和交付形式，例如「为我的咖啡店做一个介绍网页，保存为 in: Describe the goal, audience and output, e.g. “Create a website for my café and save it as index.html”. Try a task offers examples that only fill drafts; only explicitly sending creates a conversation.
点回形针上传文件，也可以直接粘贴图片。在输入框输入 @，按需引用上下文库中的背景: Use the paperclip to upload files or paste images directly. Type @ to reference background and requirements from your context library.
只会把你主动引用的上下文提供给 Agent。: Only context you explicitly reference is shared with the agent.
看执行进度，必要时调整方向: Follow progress and adjust direction when needed
发送后，可以查看回复和工具执行详情。运行时你仍可以准备下一条草稿；需要中断时点「: After sending, review replies and tool details. You can still draft while running. Stop when needed and then explain your new requirements.
一个会话同时执行一个任务。: One task runs at a time per conversation.
打开文件，看见真正的成果: Open files and see the real result
Agent 写入或编辑文件后，文件会在右侧自动打开，多份文件使用多个标签。HTM: Written or edited files open automatically on the right, each in a tab. HTML starts in preview mode with source available. Continue editing from result cards, or expand details to download.
生成文件后才会出现文件预览。手机端关闭面板即可回到对话。: Previews appear after files are created. On mobile, close the panel to return to chat.
其他功能，随用随学: Learn other features when you need them
项目整理会话；Agent 保存专门的工作方式；上下文库保存常用背景。模型、Com: Projects organize conversations; agents save specialized working styles; context stores useful background. Models, Computer, Skills and profile have separate guides, available anytime from Getting started guide.
现在可以开始自己的任务，也可以先看看某个功能的教学。: Start your own task now, or explore a feature guide first.
连接服务，添加模型，再开始任务: Connect a service, add a model and start working
模型是 Agent 的思考能力: The model provides the agent's reasoning
有共享模型时可以直接使用，凭证由管理员管理。使用自己的模型时，先选择服务商、填写: Use shared models directly; administrators manage credentials. For your own model, choose a provider and enter an API key. Compatible endpoints also require an Endpoint.
个人凭证加密保存，不向其他用户公开。: Personal credentials are encrypted and hidden from other users.
「连接服务商」保存端点与凭证；「添加模型」选择已保存的连接，填写服务商提供的 M: Connect provider saves the endpoint and credentials. Add model selects that connection and the provider's Model ID. Display name is just a label; Azure OpenAI uses the deployment name as Model ID.
已有模型时先展示列表，点「添加模型」打开表单；表单顶部的步骤可切换。云服务参数按: Existing models appear as a list; Add model opens a form with switchable steps. Enter cloud parameters as required by the provider.
保存配置，回到你的任务: Save configuration and return to your task
设为默认模型后，新会话会优先选择它。保存完成，点击「返回工作区」继续编辑刚才的草: A default model is selected first for new conversations. After saving, use Back to workspace to resume your draft. If the first run fails, check credentials, model ID, permissions and quota.
教学完成只表示你看过说明，不代表模型服务已经验证。: Finishing the tutorial means you read the instructions, not that the provider was verified.
按工作组织任务，快速找回历史: Organize work and find past tasks quickly
会话栏按项目组织。默认项目可以直接使用；点击项目区的 + 为不同产品、客户或主题: The sidebar groups conversations by project. Use the default project or + to create projects for products, clients or topics.
手机端先点左上角菜单打开会话栏。: On mobile, open the sidebar from the top-left menu.
开始会话，不需要先建空任务: Start a conversation without an empty task first
进入项目后写下目标，发送第一条消息才创建会话。用搜索找回历史任务，展开项目查看其: Enter a project, write a goal and send the first message to create a conversation. Search past tasks or expand a project to browse its conversations.
项目和会话的更多菜单支持置顶。会话菜单还可以把任务移动到另一个项目；任务的消息和: Pin projects and conversations from their menus. Move conversations to another project too; messages and files stay intact.
Agent 写入、编辑或登记文件后，确认文件存在，再自动打开预览。手机顶部点「成: Files written, edited or registered open after existence is verified. On mobile, Results opens the panel; then select Files, or use the conversation menu.
还没有会话或生成文件时，可以先了解操作，实际预览会在任务中出现。: You can learn the controls before a conversation or files exist. Actual previews appear during tasks.
右侧最多同时保留 8 个文件标签。点击切换，点 × 关闭；再次修改同一文件会刷新: Keep up to 8 file tabs on the right. Click to switch or × to close. Editing the same file refreshes its tab. HTML uses an isolated iframe with a source option.
文件标签支持方向键、Home / End 切换，Delete 关闭。: Use arrows and Home / End to switch tabs, Delete to close.
点击成果卡片预览，展开详情下载文件，或点击「继续修改」补充要求。关闭预览面板后可: Preview from a result card, open details to download or Continue editing to add requirements. Close the panel to chat. Explicitly publish only when you want a public URL.
工作区内的文件预览需要登录；公开发布是单独的操作。: Workspace previews require sign-in. Public publishing is a separate action.
为不同工作准备专门的助手: Prepare specialized assistants for different work
Agent 决定如何工作: The agent defines how work gets done
模型负责思考，Agent 定义工作方式和可用的 Skill。通用任务用 Lest: The model reasons; the agent defines working style and Skills. Use Lester for general tasks, or create an agent for recurring specialized work.
点击「与智能体设计师创建」，描述目标、边界、输出格式以及需要的材料，再在设计会话: Choose Create with the agent designer, describe goals, boundaries, output format and materials, then refine prompts, Skills and files in the design conversation.
只有你实际发送需求，才会开始设计任务。: Design starts only when you actually send your requirements.
选择 Agent，开始新的工作: Choose an agent and start new work
打开 Agent 卡片查看介绍和预设能力，再和它开始会话。已有会话保留原有设置；: Open an agent card to see its description and presets, then start a conversation. Existing conversations keep their settings. Custom agents are editable; built-in agents offer a general starting point.
保存背景，在对话里按需引用: Save background and reference it as needed
把反复解释的背景存下来: Save the context you explain repeatedly
品牌语气、团队术语、产品介绍和输出规范都可以成为上下文词条。这些内容仅自己可见，: Store brand voice, team terminology, product introductions and output guidelines as context entries. They stay private and are not added automatically to every task.
点击「新建词条」，填写名称、简介与正文，再保存。名称帮助你查找，简介帮助你判断何: Choose New entry, fill name, description and content, then save. The name helps search; the description explains when to use it; content is what the agent receives.
在聊天中输入 @ 引用: Type @ in chat to reference context
回到消息输入框，输入 @ 选择词条。发送时保存当前内容的快照；之后编辑或删除词条: Type @ in the composer and select an entry. Sending saves a snapshot; later edits or deletion do not change references in past messages.
每次最多引用 8 条；只引用和当前任务有关的内容。: Up to 8 entries per message. Reference only what's relevant to the task.
了解文件、命令和运行环境: Understand files, commands and the runtime
这是 Agent 的工作环境: This is the agent's working environment
Computer 提供运行命令和读写文件的环境。每个用户复用自己的 Comput: Computer runs commands and reads or writes files. Each user reuses a personal Computer; conversations have separate working directories.
在会话面板查看和操作: View and operate from the conversation panel
会话右侧可以查看文件、成果、终端和 Computer 状态。终端中的命令会直接影: The right panel shows files, results, terminal and Computer status. Terminal commands directly affect your workspace; confirm your intent before running them.
此设置页说明环境；实际操作入口在会话中。: This settings page explains the environment. Actual controls are in a conversation.
文件保留，环境按需恢复: Files persist; the environment resumes on demand
Computer 空闲后会暂停，下一次使用会检查并恢复。连接异常时查看真实状态和: Computer suspends when idle and checks and resumes on use. On connection errors, inspect actual status and error messages. Changing providers does not migrate workspace files automatically.
在广场浏览能力的名称、说明与版本，例如代码审查或项目规划。先选和当前任务有关的能: Browse names, descriptions and versions, such as code review or project planning. Choose capabilities relevant to this task.
浏览广场不会自动安装。打开会话的 Computer 面板，在 Skill 页按需: Browsing the catalog installs nothing automatically. Open a conversation's Computer panel and install from Skills. Custom agents can also preset Skills.
在任务中说明要审查哪些文件、规划哪个目标，或分析什么数据。Skill 提供方法，: Specify files to review, a goal to plan or data to analyze. Skills provide methods; actual results depend on goals, materials and model capabilities.
修改称呼，选择内置头像主题后点击「保存资料」。上传头像会即时保存，支持小于 2: Change your name or avatar theme and choose Save profile. Uploaded avatars save immediately. PNG, JPEG and GIF under 2 MB are supported.
部署启用 Google / GitHub 时，可在登录方式中绑定。相同邮箱不会自: If Google / GitHub is configured, link it under Sign-in methods. Identical emails do not merge accounts. Sign in to the existing account before linking, and keep at least one usable method.
保护账号，找回访问: Protect the account and recover access
在个人资料中设置或更换密码。部署配置邮件服务后可以验证邮箱，并从登录页找回密码；: Set or change a password in Profile. With mail configured, verify email and recover passwords from sign-in. Password reset requires other devices to sign in again.
未配置的第三方登录或邮件功能不会显示为可用。: Unconfigured providers and mail features are not shown as available.
把完成的成果变成可分享网址: Turn completed work into a shareable URL
产物管理集中查看已经发布的内容。会话内的文件和成果默认留在工作区；自动预览不会自: Site management shows published content. Conversation files stay private in your workspace by default; automatic preview does not publish them.
只在需要公开分享时进行发布。: Publish only when public sharing is needed.
从会话中选择入口文件和需要的资源，检查发布范围，再提交发布。公开链接可以被拿到网: Select an entry file and resources from a conversation, check the scope and submit. Anyone with the URL can access the publication; confirm it's appropriate to share.
发布完成后在产物管理中打开网址。需要更新时重新发布；不再分享时取消发布。工作区的: Open the URL in site management after publishing. Republish to update or unpublish to stop sharing. Conversations and source files remain in your workspace.

如果该账号可以进行此操作，你将收到邮件。请检查收件箱和垃圾邮件。: If this account can perform the action, you will receive an email. Check your inbox and spam folder.

可在官网导航、登录页、账户菜单或设置侧栏切换界面语言。首次访问跟随浏览器偏好，支: Change the interface language in the website header, sign-in page, account menu or settings sidebar. On your first visit, Lester follows your browser preference and supports Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, French and Spanish. An explicit choice is remembered in this browser for one year. Switching preserves drafts and local attachments; user messages and generated files stay as authored.
Compose 会先构建完整沙盒镜像，供新建的 Computer 使用。镜像预装: Compose first builds the complete sandbox image for new Computers. It includes Node.js, npm, pnpm, Python, pip, venv, Go and common build tools. Node.js and Python Playwright share predownloaded Chromium, with Chinese, Japanese and Korean fonts included.
Docker Computer 默认禁用外网。预装浏览器可以测试本地页面；安装新: Docker Computers have external networking disabled by default. The preinstalled browser can test local pages; installing new dependencies or visiting external websites still requires deployment network configuration.
重建镜像不会升级已有 Computer，也不会删除工作区。旧配置需更新 SAND: Rebuilding the image does not upgrade existing Computers or delete workspaces. Update SANDBOX_IMAGE in older configurations; an administrator must retain volumes, plan migration of existing Computers and check file permissions for the non-root user. ACS requires pushing the new image and updating its template.
